{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit top: slim fit, softly fitted, with a boat neckline and long sleeves, hip length, in warm ivory #EFE6DC, merino-silk blend.

Skirt: A-line midi, falling just below the knee, with a smooth waistband and soft movement, in deep plum #5E2A45, crepe with a matte finish.

Textured jacket: single-breasted, slightly shaped, hip length, with a soft shoulder line, in slate blue-grey #3E4C63, wool tweed with a subtle weave.

Sheer tights: thin, smooth, in black #1E1B1D, matte nylon.

Ankle boots: low block heel, almond toe, sleek shaft, in black #1E1B1D, soft leather.

Bag: small structured top-handle bag in black #1E1B1D, smooth leather.

Earrings: small drop earrings in silver tone #C0C0C8, polished metal.

Why this outfit works: The plum, ivory and slate blue-grey sit in a deep, soft palette that flatters her fair skin, dark hair and blue-grey eyes. The ivory knit brings brightness near her face, and the slate jacket echoes the color of her eyes. The tweed jacket and the fine knit give a neat, polished look right for a theatre evening, and the jacket also covers the cooler autumn night. The midi skirt and low block-heel boots are comfortable for sitting through a performance while keeping the look elegant under the warm artificial light of the foyer."}
